set.body: Per decision q-provenance-cache. Non-cryptographic (xxHash-style) digest over numeric payload plus geometry. Computed once at ingest, memoized, propagated through derived objects. MUST be identical on JVM and Scala.js (DET-2, DET-4). Makes Provenance a valid cache key by construction (APP-12) and is the join point with repro4s.
set.title: ContentHash: fast input digest for provenance and caching
